title: 第011章 买玉第012章 交易

第011章买玉
陈默扶着李素芳，就在李家人众目睽睽之下，嘴角含着冷笑，淡然离开，视李家众人如无物。
李家众人怒目而视，却无一人敢出手阻拦，即便是号称李家年轻一代第一人的李泽，或是那两名隐藏在暗处的老者，都不敢有任何异动。
他们都清楚，一名内境武者所代表的意义。若是陈默拼死一搏，就算最后能把他留下，这满院子的李家众人，最后能完好无损站着的，绝对不会超过三成。这便是内境武者的恐怖！
只是，他们并不清楚陈默的底细，若是他们知道，在他们眼中如此恐怖的内境武者，其实，对陈默来说，根本还算不上一个合格的修仙者，不知会作何感想？
离开李家大院，陈默带着老妈李素芳拦了一辆出租车。
“师傅，送我们去燕京最繁华地段，最好的酒店！”
“好嘞，你觉得王府大酒店那疙瘩咋样？位置在二环辅路，那地方老繁华了！”司机带着浓重的东北口音说道。
陈默点头：“可以！”
虽然离开李家，陈默心中并未放松警惕，这一世，李家给他的惊讶太多了。
外境武者李越，内境武者李泽，还有隐藏在暗处的那两名更强大的老者，甚至都能威胁到如今的陈默！
这一切，都让陈默产生强烈的危机。
只有在繁华地段，李家才不敢放肆，而且最好的酒店，意味着安防系统也相对完善。
陈默这是在防着李家下黑手。
来到王府酒店，陈默对这里很满意，按照王府酒店附近的人流量，若是李家敢在这里动手，即便他是华夏国六大超级世家之一，也要承受整个华夏国高层的怒火。
陈默遨游宇宙星空，去过无数有着智慧生命的星球，对每个星球当权者都有一定的了解，有些东西，是绝对不允许出现在普通百姓眼中的，比如，武者！
付了车费，陈默带着李素芳走进酒店，要了两间房。
陈默扶着李素芳进了房间，李素芳心神具疲，但却有些疑惑。坐在床上，看着陈默问道：“小默，什么是内境武者？你去武州上学这段时间，发生了什么？你怎么会突然变得那么厉害？”
陈默心中暗暗思量，看来老妈并不清楚李家真正的底蕴，显然，李家人故意瞒着她。
面对老妈的疑问，陈默早就想好了说辞：“老妈，我在武州上学期间，遇到一位奇怪的老人，他教了我一些呼吸吐纳之法和拳脚功夫，所以李越那些人根本不是我对手。”

李素芳有些狐疑的盯着陈默，陈默赶忙补充道：“老妈您放心，我保证那不是坏事。而且您儿子已经长大了，知道什么该做什么不该做。”
李素芳看出了陈默不想和她解释太清楚，也不想强迫他，点点头道：“好吧，既然你有自己的想法，那我就不去过多干涉你，但是，你一定要保证自己的安全！”
感受到李素芳话里透出的浓浓关怀，陈默心中涌起一股暖流：“恩，老妈放心，这世界上，还没人能伤的了我！”
李素芳爱怜的喝骂道：“呸，刚夸你两句，你又开始胡说八道！”
“哈哈！”陈默并未解释，他明白就算解释也解释不清，而且如果李素芳知道的太多，万一泄露他修仙者的身份，反而会给李素芳带来危险。等到他变得足够强大，有能力保护家人的安全，再把一切都告诉父母。
“行了，我累了，你回去休息吧！”李素芳说道。
陈默点点头：“好，那儿子不打扰您休息了。”
回到了隔壁的房间，陈默没有睡觉，通过刚才在李家的经历，陈默心中的危机感更深了，尽快提升修为，是陈默眼下最重要的事情。
反锁房门，陈默立刻盘膝坐在墙角，运转玄天升龙道，并分出一丝意念，附在隔壁李素芳的身上，防止李家人报复。
第二天一早，陈默和李素芳坐飞机返回汉阳市。
中午十二点半到达汉阳。
离开机场，两人来到路边等出租车。
李素芳问：“小默，你要不要留在汉阳市玩几天？”
content_en:
Chapter 011 Buying Jade
Chen Mo supported Li Sufang, and in full view of the Li family, he left with a sneer on his lips, treating the Li family as if they were nothing.
Everyone in the Li family stared angrily, but no one dared to stop him. Even Li Ze, who was known as the leader of the younger generation of the Li family, or the two old men hiding in the dark, did not dare to make any move.
They all know what an inner warrior represents. If Chen Mo fights to the death, even if he can stay in the end, there will definitely not be more than 30% of the Li family members in the yard who will be able to stand intact in the end. This is the terror of inner warriors!
However, they don't know the details of Chen Mo. What would they think if they knew that the inner warrior who was so terrifying in their eyes was actually not a qualified immortal cultivator to Chen Mo?
After leaving the Li family compound, Chen Mo and his mother Li Sufang stopped a taxi.
"Master, take us to the best hotel in the most prosperous area of Yanjing!"
"Okay, what do you think of the hotel? It's located on the Second Ring Road, and that place is so prosperous!" the driver said with a strong Northeastern accent.
Chen Mo nodded: "Okay!"
Although he left the Li family, Chen Mo did not relax his vigilance. In this life, the Li family had given him too many surprises.
The external warrior Li Yue, the internal warrior Li Ze, and the two more powerful old men hiding in the dark can even threaten Chen Mo today!
All this gave Chen Mo a strong crisis.
Only in prosperous areas do the Li family dare not act arrogantly, and the best hotels mean that the security system is relatively complete.
Chen Mo was trying to prevent the Li family from committing evil acts.
Arriving at the Wangfu Hotel, Chen Mo was very satisfied with the place. According to the flow of people near the Wangfu Hotel, if the Li family dared to take action here, even if he was one of the six super aristocratic families in the Huaxia Kingdom, he would have to bear the wrath of the entire Huaxia Kingdom's top brass.
Chen Mo has traveled across the universe and visited countless planets with intelligent life. He has a certain understanding of the people in power on each planet. There are some things that are absolutely not allowed to appear in the eyes of ordinary people, such as warriors!
After paying the fare, Chen Mo took Li Sufang into the hotel and asked for two rooms.
Chen Mo helped Li Sufang into the room. Li Sufang felt tired but a little confused. Sitting on the bed, he looked at Chen Mo and asked: "Xiao Mo, what is an inner warrior? What happened when you went to school in Wuzhou? How did you suddenly become so powerful?"
Chen Mo thought secretly in his heart. It seemed that his mother did not know the true background of the Li family. Obviously, the Li family deliberately hid it from her.
Facing his mother's question, Chen Mo had already thought of his answer: "Mom, when I was studying in Wuzhou, I met a strange old man. He taught me some breathing techniques and boxing skills, so people like Li Yue are no match for me at all."
Li Sufang stared at Chen Mo suspiciously, and Chen Mo quickly added: "Mom, don't worry, I promise it's not a bad thing. And your son has grown up and knows what he should and should not do."
Li Sufang saw that Chen Mo didn't want to explain too clearly to her, nor did she want to force him, so she nodded and said: "Okay, since you have your own ideas, I won't interfere with you too much, but you must ensure your own safety!"
Feeling the deep concern in Li Sufang's words, Chen Mo felt a warm current in his heart: "Well, don't worry, mom, no one in this world can hurt me!"
Li Sufang cursed lovingly: "Bah, I just complimented you a few words, and you started talking nonsense again!"
"Haha!" Chen Mo didn't explain. He knew that even if he explained, he couldn't explain it clearly, and if Li Sufang knew too much, it would bring danger to Li Sufang if his identity as an immortal cultivator was revealed. Wait until he becomes strong enough to keep his family safe before telling his parents everything.
"Okay, I'm tired, you go backGo and rest! "Li Sufang said.
Chen Mo nodded: "Okay, my son won't disturb your rest. "
Returning to the next room, Chen Mo didn't sleep. After his experience at Li's house, Chen Mo's sense of crisis deepened. Improving his cultivation level as soon as possible was the most important thing for Chen Mo right now.
After locking the door, Chen Mo immediately sat cross-legged in the corner, running the Xuantian Ascending Dragon Path, and sent out a trace of his mind to attach to Li Sufang next door to prevent the Li family from retaliating.
Early the next morning, Chen Mo and Li Sufang took a flight back to Hanyang City.
Arrive in Hanyang at 12:30 noon.
After leaving the airport, the two of them went to the roadside to wait for a taxi.
Li Sufang asked: "Xiao Mo, do you want to stay in Hanyang City for a few days? "
